candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

design.equivalence_rule: only an interval wholly inside [-epsilon,+epsilon] supports practical equivalence; crossing zero alone does not
design.fresh_start_semantics: one torchrun process group per start; every start reloads all immutable artifacts and rebuilds weights before warmup
design.response_definition: start-level Q(candidate vs base) = mean of the five paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced_us_per_forward(base) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(candidate) within the same randomized block

stopping_study_spec.base: deterministic low-r lexicographic greedy legal-swap local optimum
candidate_strata: four locked-M2 predictions closest to zero

timing.schedule_algorithm: random.Random(seed + block).shuffle over the frozen timed layout order (base + twelve residual candidates; identity is never timed)
